battleTraits.name: The Hunger
battleTraits.effect: The Hunger (Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn): Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a Fight ability

battleTraits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battleTraits.effect: The Unquiet Dead (Deployment Phase): Set up that unit in reserve in the grave. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions
battleTraits.effect:
Endless Legions (Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase): Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Hero  or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use Charge abilities this turn.

battleTraits.name: Deathly Invocation
battleTraits.effect:
Deathly Invocation (Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase): For each target:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

battleTraits.name: The Rising Dead
battleTraits.effect: The Rising Dead (Your Movement Phase): Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy unit, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory, and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Ancient Burial Sites
battleTraits.effect:
Ancient Burial Sites (Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase): If there is a friendly Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield, you can set up to 2 additional friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives, and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.
Designer's Note: *The original* Cursed Sepulchre *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

artefacts.name: Terminus Clock
artefacts.effect: Terminus Clock: Your Hero Phase Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy Wizards while they are within 18" of this unit.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Graves
artefacts.effect: Amulet of Graves: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase If there are fewer than 3 friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield, set up a Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

artefacts.name: Shard of Night
artefacts.effect: Shard of Night: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Ego
heroicTraits.effect: Immortal Ego: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Eternal Thrall
heroicTraits.effect:
Eternal Thrall: Deployment Phase Pick another friendly non-Unique Soulblight Gravelords Infantry Hero to be the target. For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a Necromancer, add 1 to this unit's power level.
• If this unit is a Vampire, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is Deathrattle, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

heroicTraits.name: Furious Endings
heroicTraits.effect: Furious Endings: Each time a Manifestation within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 rage dice.

heroicTraits.name: Lash of the Sire
heroicTraits.effect:
Lash of the Sire: Your Hero Phase Pick another friendly Soulblight Gravelords unit within this unit's combat range to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of the move. 
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

heroicTraits.name: Unbending Will
heroicTraits.effect: Unbending Will: Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Add D6 to the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

heroicTraits.name: Unhinged Rampager
heroicTraits.effect: Unhinged Rampager: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

heroicTraits.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
heroicTraits.effect:
A Wastrel and a Vagabond: While a friendly Deadwalker Zombies or Deathrattle Skeletons unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.

heroicTraits.name: Frightening Vitality
heroicTraits.effect: Frightening Vitality: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit's damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Ego
heroicTraits.effect: Immortal Ego: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

battleFormations.name: Deathstench Drove
battleFormations.effect:
Dragged Down and Torn Apart: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick up to 3 friendly Deadwalkers units in combat to be the targets. For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battleFormations.name: Bacchanal of Blood
battleFormations.effect: Aristocracy of the Night: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Vampire units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.

battleFormations.name: Deathmarch
battleFormations.effect: Tide of Bones and Blades: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Deathrattle units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

battleFormations.name: Legion of Shyish
battleFormations.effect: Horror Unending: You can pick 1 additional target when using the 'Deathly Invocation' ability.

battleFormations.name: Legions of Ulfenkarn
battleFormations.effect: Wardens of the Wolf: Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Infantry or Beast unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Belladamma Volga, Radukar the Wolf, Radukar the Beast, Ivya Volga, Lady Annika, Kritza, Torgillius the Chamberlain, Gorslav the Gravekeeper or Watch Captain Halgrim, add 1 to the number of slain models returned to that unit.

battleFormations.name: Cryptmasters
battleFormations.effect: Unhallowed Site: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly Cursed Sepulchre to be the target. The target has Ward (4+) until the start of your next turn.

battleFormations.name: Skinshifters
battleFormations.effect: The Speed of Death: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly Infantry Vampire Hero to be the target. The target can move up to 12" and has Fly when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.
